scope_rule: Mother library serves all future design styles. Current design collections and social/miniapp market scans are evidence inputs, not library boundaries.
taxonomy_rule: CRM-M-0066 菩提籽类 remains only as a historical/taxonomy parent and is not an actual selectable or procurement material.
purchase_rule: Inclusion in the mother library does not authorize purchase. Low/mid/high quality guidance, offline sourcing views and exact procurement specs must be derived later from evidence and sourcing requirements.
excel_rule: Do not generate the user-facing Excel until user review is complete. Future Excel is an export/view of this mother database and must include a single-bead/single-item image field.
offline_sourcing_rule: Offline sourcing is a filtered export from the mother library, not a separate master database.
